name: Formula 1
author: Pranay Shekar
description: Live Formula 1 timing for the Omarchy bar: session state, live classification, and cars moving on the real circuit, from the public formula1.com timing feed. Championship data from Jolpica. No account, no key, no paid service.

barWidget.description: Live F1 timing: next race, session, lap, and cars on the circuit.

schema.label: Replay capture directory
schema.description: Replay a recorded session instead of the live feed, for development and demos. Leave empty for normal live use. The panel shows a REPLAY badge whenever this is set.
